Lesson Topic: Around the House

Welcome to Your Digital Classroom

Today we'll explore vocabulary about homes, furniture, and daily routines. Work through each interactive activity to practice nouns, verbs, and adjectives related to life "Around the House".

Click Next

Give clues using sentences like: "It's a place where..." or "You use it to..."

Activity 4: Vocabulary Hunt - "My New Home"

Find and highlight words in the text

Instructions: Read the text below. Select highlight mode, then click words to highlight them. Blue = Nouns, Green = Verbs, Yellow = Adjectives.

Last month, I moved into my new house. It's a beautiful two-story building with a spacious living room. Every morning, I cook breakfast in the modern kitchen and enjoy coffee on the balcony.

After breakfast, I clean the dining room and wash the dishes. The dining table is wooden and sturdy. My bedroom is cozy with a comfortable bed where I sleep every night.

In the laundry room, I wash clothes on weekends. The stove works perfectly for cooking meals. My sofa is soft and I relax there while watching TV with my family.

I work in my home office during the day. The workspace is organized and quiet. After work, I prepare dinner in the pantry and store food in the refrigerator. This house feels perfect for my comfortable life.

Activity 6: Pair Speaking

Dice game for speaking practice

Instructions: Roll the dice to get a question. Answer with your partner using the vocabulary you've learned.

?

Click "Roll Dice" to get your question!

Speaking Prompts:
  • 1: What do you do in the living room?
  • 2: Name three items in the kitchen.
  • 3: Describe your bedroom.
  • 4: What do you do in the bathroom?
  • 5: What's your favorite room at home?
  • 6: Tell a chore you do at home.

Activity 8: Describe and Guess

Pair speaking game with random house vocabulary

Instructions: Work in pairs. One student looks at the word and describes it without saying the word. The partner guesses. Then switch roles.

Speaking Rules:
  • 1. Do not say the word on the screen.
  • 2. Describe where it is, what people do with it, or what it looks like.
  • 3. Your partner gets one point for each correct guess.
